title: Senior Infrastructure Solutions Architect - OEM Deployment
description_html: NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.   We are now looking for an Infrastructure Solutions Architect! NVIDIA’s AI platforms have already made a major impact across leading academic institutions, start-ups, and the world’s largest enterprise companies. We need passionate, creative, and driven individuals to help us continue delivering groundbreaking enterprise solutions. This role is ideal for a specialist in system design and networking who can lead customers through the AI computing revolution. You will be leading technical deployments of NVIDIA AI systems, collaborate cross-functionally, support NCP (NVIDIA Cloud Partner) and Enterprise integration.    What you’ll be doing:    Provide onsite technical leadership for large-scale NVIDIA AI datacenter deployments, ensuring seamless integration and customer happiness.  Troubleshoot and resolve complex hardware and deployment issues across GPU, networking, and storage technologies.  Act as a technical expert supporting sales teams, driving adoption of NVIDIA solutions through close collaboration with customers and internal collaborators.  Lead technical engagement with customer engineers, architects, and decision-makers to identify system architectures and key product requirements in the enterprise AI space.  Support technical engagement with NCPs (NVIDIA Cloud Partners) and Enterprise customers to accelerate the deployment and adoption of NVIDIA AI technologies in cloud environments, ensuring time-to-value and successful integration.     What we need to see:    Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.  8+ years of experience in system design or technical customer support within the technology industry, including hands-on involvement in cloud partner architecture/solution validation, deployment, and scaling activities. This is a field facing role and requires up to 50% travel to customers, partners and datacenters.  Deep knowledge of datacenter hardware such as servers, storage systems, and network devices.  Strong analytical, problem-solving, time-management, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple complex initiatives in dynamic environments.  Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to collaborate effectively across engineering and leadership teams.     Ways to stand out from the crowd:    Proven experience with large-scale datacenter rollouts and integration of solutions with NCP (NVIDIA Cloud Partner) and Enterprise platforms, including support for large-scale cloud deployment and the ability to scale production efficiently.  Strong networking expertise across TCP/IP, RDMA, RoCE, NICs, and switches, with a solid understanding of CPU architecture and embedded Linux systems, APIs, and OS environments.  Proficiency in Bash scripting, Ansible and Python programming, enabling automation, diagnostics, and performance tuning across complex system environments.  Deep knowledge of GPU and DPU technologies, including NCCL for high-performance communication in multi-GPU systems.  Familiarity with signal integrity principles, thermal management (HVAC and cooling), power distribution, cabling, and rack layout—especially in industrial, military, and ruggedized computing environments.    NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative, results-oriented and enjoy learning while having fun, then what are you waiting for? Apply today!     Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 184,000 USD - 287,500 USD.           You will also be eligible for equity and  benefits .           Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 17, 2026.   This posting is for an existing vacancy.   NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.   NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Solutions Architect, Metronome (Startups)
Manager, Solutions Architecture — Oracle AI Software
description_html: We are looking for a candidate to join NVIDIA’s dynamic team as a Manager, Solutions Architecture for Oracle AI Software. Here, you will partner with world-class talent to encourage the integration of NVIDIA’s AI software stack and innovative technologies throughout Oracle. This opportunity is distinctively placed to impact the future of AI solutions and boost Oracle's AI capabilities. If you are enthusiastic about generative AI, inference, and agentic AI, and have shown the ability to guide technical teams, this role is perfect for you!      What you’ll be doing:       Leading and developing a high-performing team of Solutions Architects. You will prioritize tasks, provide technical mentoring, and develop an inclusive, collaborative environment.    Leading the integration and adoption of NVIDIA’s AI software stack and open-weight models within Oracle’s platforms, services, and customer solutions.    Working together with Oracle engineering and product leaders to define architectures and integration strategies for generative AI, inference, and agentic AI.    Guiding technical engagements from discovery through to production deployment, aligning achievements, resolving technical challenges, and measuring success.    Optimizing model serving for performance, latency, efficiency, scalability, and cost across enterprise workloads.    Engaging with Oracle customers to understand business needs, demonstrate technical value, and guide adoption through workshops, architecture reviews, and executive discussions.    Collaborating with NVIDIA teams to bring customer feedback into product decisions and align efforts with business priorities.       What we need to see:       BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.    At least 10 overall years of experience in a technical role, with a minimum of 4 years leading people or complex technical projects.    Strong technical expertise in generative AI, including large language models, model evaluation, and deployment of open-weight models.    Practical experience with AI inference, model serving, performance optimization, and deploying workloads on accelerated computing infrastructure.    Experience building or deploying agentic AI applications, with an understanding of retrieval, tool use, orchestration, and evaluation.    Demonstrated skill in guiding technical teams, advising engineers, and completing projects that span multiple departments.    Excellent communication and interpersonal capabilities, enabling the simplification of complex technical concepts for engineers, customers, and senior management.    A customer-focused method with the ability to convert business needs into technical strategies and operational solutions.       Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:       Experience working with Oracle, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, or Oracle’s suite of enterprise software.    Experience leading a customer-facing Solutions Architecture or engineering team.    Hands-on experience with NVIDIA’s AI software stack, GPU acceleration, and production inference technologies.    A track record of driving technology adoption through strategic partnerships, joint engineering, or enterprise customer engagements.    Demonstrated success in optimizing AI workloads using benchmarks and achieving measurable improvements in performance, reliability, or cost.       Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 224,000 USD - 356,500 USD for Level 3, and 272,000 USD - 431,250 USD for Level 4.           You will also be eligible for equity and  benefits .           Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 17, 2026.   This posting is for an existing vacancy.   NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.
